Customer quote: 'We cannot allow model outputs to leave our tenant. Need proof of audit trails and BYOK.'

Technical constraints: EKS on dedicated subnets, no public IPv4 for inference pods, VPC endpoints to S3 and ECR, cross-account IAM role for Redwood push of images, CloudWatch -> Splunk forwarder for logs

POC deliverables: 1) Terraform modules + Helm charts that bootstrap Redwood operator into customer VPC, 2) automated integration tests (latency/throughput), 3) audit log stream to Splunk and retention policy enforcement, 4) KMS integration sample (AWS KMS + HSM reference), 5) runbook for canary rollback and model pinning

Acceptance criteria (customer): avg tail latency < 150ms for 512-token chat flows (95th pct), steady throughput of 50-75 req/s under dedicated pool, audit logs present for token-level events and stored in EU region for 90 days, KMS-encrypted model keys with access logs available to security team

Helm values include enableAudit=true, logLevel=INFO, storageClass=efs-encrypted. Demonstrated quantized model variant to reduce GPU memory and cost during POC.
